## Line 93

```plato

    // The blend between the bracketing stop pair. Precondition: at least one stop.
    GradientSample(self: ColorGradient, t: Number): Color {
        var index = self.StopIndexAt(t);
        var lower = self.Stops[index];
        var upper = self.Stops[(index + 1).Min(self.Stops.Count - 1)];
        var span = upper.Position - lower.Position;
        var local = span <= 0.0 ? 0.0 : ((t - lower.Position) / span).Clamp(0.0, 1.0);
        return lower.Color.Lerp(upper.Color, local);
    }
```
